setup_audio_pretraining_task: setup an AudioPretrainingTask with config to load target dictionaries for fine-tuning
load_audio_dataset: load an audio dataset from a TSV manifest with optional label targets for fine-tuning
encode_labels_with_labelencoder: encode text labels into token IDs using a LabelEncoder and fairseq Dictionary
compute_wer_during_validation: compute word error rate during validation using beam search inference and edit distance
reduce_wer_metrics: reduce logging outputs to derive WER and UER scalar metrics for audio pretraining
